history.interpretation: Failed assertion used vertical font Range em-box extents as layout overflow. All108 selected titles were marked although ordinary font ascent can extend beyond tight line-height. This was a QA observer false positive. Independently, room34 intrinsic width genuinely exceeded viewport at320/820/1100; native before images preserve that defect. V2 checks parent/viewport horizontal bounds and actual hidden/clip overflow, and preserves canonical titles via SHY removal plus exact aria-label.
